title: Guitar-first practice path
semantics: Project practice suggestions in a provisional order. Practised is an optional self-report, not mastery, recording-specific arrangement approval, or a chord/timing accuracy label. Riff guides are separate from the rhythm path. Selection/order updated after founder feedback; progress-compatible path revision and retained step identities stay unchanged. Standard-tuning teaching setups are not independently verified recording tunings.

steps.title: Wild Thing
steps.skill_focus: Keep open-chord changes steady; add the contrasting figure later.
steps.setup_note: Teacher setup: E standard (EADGBE). The exact recording's physical tuning/capo remains unchecked.

steps.title: Knockin' On Heaven's Door

recording.title: Bob Dylan - Knockin' On Heaven's Door

steps.skill_focus: Add Am to steady changes; leave flowing subdivisions and picking for later.
steps.setup_note: The teacher uses standard tuning. Capo and exact recording pitch remain unchecked.

sources.title: Jon MacLennan: Knockin' On Heaven's Door

steps.title: Brown Eyed Girl
steps.skill_focus: Maintain down/up movement through chord changes; try skipped contacts later.
steps.prerequisites: Four open shapes and down/up movement
steps.setup_note: Standard tuning is supported by a separate teaching arrangement; capo and exact recording pitch remain unchecked.

sources.title: Andy Guitar: down/up strumming with a tie
David Stanley Guitar: Brown Eyed Girl easy arrangement

steps.title: Twist And Shout
steps.skill_focus: Keep D/G/A changes moving at a quicker feel; the all-down build-up is later work.
steps.prerequisites: D/G/A changes at a quicker feel
steps.setup_note: Teacher setup: E standard (EADGBE). The exact recording's physical tuning/capo remains unchecked.

steps.title: The House Of The Rising Sun

recording.title: The Animals - The House Of The Rising Sun

steps.skill_focus: Count six eighth notes, grouped 3 + 3; start with gentle strums on 1 and 4.
steps.setup_note: Teacher setup: no capo. Small F is an entry option; the recorded guitar uses arpeggios. Exact recording pitch remains unchecked.

sources.title: Jon MacLennan: House Of The Rising Sun
Carl Brown: House Of The Rising Sun
Jonathan Richter: House Of The Rising Sun

steps.title: Wonderwall
steps.skill_focus: Practise shared-finger shapes and steady motion before adding syncopation.
steps.prerequisites: Capo setup, shared-finger shapes and syncopation
steps.setup_note: Teacher setup: standard tuning, capo 2, shared-finger Em7/G/Dsus4/A7sus4/Cadd9 shapes. The automatic chart may not show these voicings; exact recording pitch remains unchecked.

steps.title: Creep
steps.skill_focus: Practise reliable barre shapes and the change from C major to C minor.
steps.setup_note: Barre-grip practice proposal: G/B/C/Cm. Preserve B major and C minor. Capo and exact recording pitch remain unchecked; verse picking is a later task.

guides.title: Seven Nation Army

recording.title: The White Stripes - Seven Nation Army

guides.skill_focus: Single-note timing and muting; fuller power-shape practice comes later.
guides.setup_note: The original setup uses Open A; the linked beginner lesson offers a standard-tuning adaptation. These are separate arrangements.
guides.note: The chord display and strumming arrows do not teach the riff. Use the linked teaching guide for its notes and fingering. Exact recording pitch remains unchecked.

guides.title: Come As You Are
guides.skill_focus: Repeated riff timing and articulation; chord rhythm sections come later.
guides.setup_note: The studio lesson uses D standard (DGCFAD). Common live E-flat standard is a different setup; current chord labels show sounding pitches.
guides.note: The chord display and strumming arrows do not teach the riff. Use the linked teaching guide for its notes and fingering. Exact recording pitch remains unchecked.

sources.title: Carl Brown: Come As You Are
